# Warren Bros Fencing

> Family-owned fence company in Wichita, KS specializing in cedar and wood fences. Cedar privacy fence installation, wood fence repair, and old fence tear-out. Built by brothers Grant and Alex Warren. Free in-person estimates.

## About

Warren Bros Fencing is a small, owner-operated fence company serving Wichita, KS and surrounding communities. We install cedar privacy fences, repair existing wood fences, and tear out old failing fences. Every quote is in-person and free.

Built by brothers Grant and Alex Warren. Cedar specialty. Built for Kansas clay, wind, and weather.

## Services

- Cedar privacy fence installation
- Wood fence installation
- Wood fence repair
- Old fence tear-out and removal
- Shadowbox, board-on-board, and picket fence styles

## Service area

Wichita, KS and surrounding metro: Derby, Andover, Goddard, Maize, Haysville, Augusta, Park City, Bel Aire, Valley Center.

## Pricing approach

We do not publish prices online because cedar fence pricing depends on linear footage, terrain (Kansas clay matters), tear-out requirements, gate count, and material grade. Every quote is free and in person. Most residential cedar privacy fence projects in Wichita run between $35 and $55 per linear foot installed, but your actual quote is built around your specific yard.
